app/src/lib/pokeapi.ts:174-208 — type-slot reconstruction, the riskiest data logic, completely untested
app/src/pages/index.astro:33-46 — filter/pagination/URL-state math untested and duplicated client-side at index.astro:228-247
app/src/lib/pokeapi.ts:259-350 — version-group/method ordering and level-up sort untested
coverage_of_risk.rationale: No tests exist, so none of the high-risk logic (data transformation, filtering, pagination, URL state) is covered despite the data layer being pure and easily testable.

evidence: app/src — recursive grep for test/spec/vitest/playwright/node:test returns zero test files
behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: There are no tests, behavioural or otherwise.

evidence: app/src/lib/pokeapi.ts:246-257 — the id>10000 alternate-form guard has no test; a silent edit leaks Mega forms into every 'Learned by' list
app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:220-261 — client-side sort (missing-sorts-last, aria-sort toggling) would regress silently
app/src/lib/pokeapi.ts:82-90 — latest-English flavor-text selection and whitespace collapse would not fail any test if broken
regression_power.rationale: Once the acceptance suite is no longer the only guard, any break in the data layer or client scripts ships unnoticed; nothing in the app can fail.

evidence: app/src — zero test files, so also zero trivial or duplicated tests
signal_to_noise.rationale: No tests means no padding, but also no signal; rubric assigns neutral 3 for an empty suite.

findings.issue: Type-slot reconstruction for all 1,025 species (including the slot fallback at line 185 that can collide) has no test coverage
findings.suggestion: Unit-test getPokedexData with a stubbed api() covering mono-type, dual-type slot order, alternate forms (>10000), and a species absent from every type list

findings.issue: Filtering, page clamping and URL-serialization are implemented twice (server vs client script at lines 143-160/228-247) with nothing pinning them together
findings.suggestion: Extract filter/pagination into a shared module in src/lib, test it (empty q omitted, page=1 omitted, clamp beyond last page), and use it from both the frontmatter and the client script

findings.issue: The moves pipeline encodes the spec's hardest ordering rules (default game by highest order, method order, level-up sort) with zero tests
findings.suggestion: Test getPokemonMovesData with a small fixture pokemon: default game selection, ?game override to an unknown value, method ordering including an 'other' method, level-up ties broken by name

findings.issue: Alternate-form exclusion and dedup in mapPokemonToSpecies unguarded; a regression leaks forms into /moves, /abilities and /types lists
findings.suggestion: Unit test with deoxys-normal (id 386 vs >10000 forms), duplicate entries, and unmapped ids

findings.issue: Client-side sortable tables (numeric vs text compare, '—' sorts last in both directions, aria-sort lifecycle) are only covered by acceptance tests
findings.suggestion: Add a small client test (e.g. webtest/vitest browser mode or a Playwright test owned by the app) that sorts each column twice and asserts row order and aria-sort

findings.issue: humanize, latestEnglishFlavorText and collapseWhitespace — the display-name and flavor-text rules — are pure functions with no tests despite tricky edge cases ('mr-mime', entries with no en language)
findings.suggestion: A five-case vitest suite for these exports would cost minutes and guard the most-reused helpers in the app

findings.issue: 404-vs-500 error handling (isNotFound at pokeapi.ts:92-94 plus per-page try/catch) is untested
findings.suggestion: Test that an unknown name returns 404 with the not-found content and that a non-404 ApiError propagates (500), via a request-level test against a stubbed API

findings.issue: Hidden-ability flag mapping re-implements idFromUrl's regex inline instead of reusing it, untested
findings.suggestion: Reuse idFromUrl from pokeapi.ts and cover the hidden-flag propagation in a unit test of the ability-page data assembly

summary: The app ships no tests of any kind: no runner, no script, no test files, leaving the acceptance suite as the sole guard. The most fragile logic — the type-slot index build, the duplicated server/client filter and pagination code, the moves ordering pipeline, and alternate-form exclusion — is exactly the code a data-layer refactor would break silently. The data layer in src/lib/pokeapi.ts is pure and trivially unit-testable, so adding a small vitest suite around it is the highest-leverage follow-up.
